verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an on-prem/self-host path (Helm chart, on-prem container types, Enterprise on-prem overview) and notes its underlying models (Marker, Surya, Chandra) are open source, but the packaged 'core product' self-host deployment is explicitly gated behind an Enterprise contract rather than freely self-hostable by any AI-native user. Missing for 10: a free/open self-hosting route without a paid Enterprise contract, and independent hands-on confirmation of a successful self-hosted deployment.
